BiblicalUsage: A bachown is an assayer — the man who tests metals. Jeremiah says God has set the prophet as a tower and a fortress among his people, that he may know and try their way, as an assayer tries silver.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God sets his prophets as assayers among his people, to know what is real metal and what is dross — and I want my own faith to pass the test.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
